sentences.text: 1. By way of present application, the applicant/petitioner seeks condonation of delay of 23 days in filing the petition.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, the application is allowed and the delay of 23 days is condoned.
3. Application is disposed of.

1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

By way of present petition filed under Sections 401/397 read with Section 482 Cr.P.C., the petitioner seeks to assail the order dated 02.01.2024 passed by Ld. ASJ (FTSC) (RC), East/KKD Courts in SC No. 1322/2022 whereby charge has been framed under Sections 376(2)(n)/
